text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock B at 123.61 and buying it back at 140.69 taught me not to treat a gain as a signal to exit; I should have a clear reason and plan before selling.","My Stock D trades produced little apparent benefit, so I should be patient and avoid acting just to feel engaged when holding is reasonable.","Periods 7, 9 and 10 showed that my account can grow without trades; I should compare each proposed trade with doing nothing and consider its effect on the whole portfolio."]}
